Rina: quick post  ran the holdback quant + routing sanity for the new 9b candidate. need a compact econ + risk note for GTN.
Diego: results uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-test/3240001234. TL;DR below.
Kai: please give per-100k tokens, p95, and where quality moved.
Diego: baseline (prod 13b-int8) per-100k = $9.75, p95=330ms, longform F1=0.897.
experiment (9b-int4 + light priming + hybrid route) per-100k = $5.20, p95=355ms, longform F1=0.886.
Rina: net ~47% nominal savings; if we add cheap rerank on 4% traffic net ~43%.
Kai: where's the drop concentrated? hallucination or summarization structure?
Diego: mostly multi-paragraph coherence on >700 token outputs; extraction/QA parity. small factual recall dip on multi-sentence lists.
Rina: product requires <0.01 longform F1 loss. routing + rerank might recover. Proposal: length+confidence routing.
- short (<200): 9b-int4 primary (85%), fallback 13b-int8 on low-conf
- mid (200-700): 9b-int4 primary (65%), fallback 13b-int8 (35%)
- long (>700): 13b-int8 primary, 9b drafts for latency then re-roll if low-conf
Add KV warmstart for active sessions to reduce p95.
Diego: sim of that policy -> ~35-40% cost reduction vs baseline, longform F1 within 0.006 if we rerank flagged outputs with the cheap flow.
Kai: rollout plan?
Rina: flag `holdback.quant9b.v1`. Canary 2% -> 10% -> 30% with automated human-sample 0.15% for 14 days. Rollback triggers: longform_F1_drop > 0.01 abs, regen_rate > 1.5x, or p95 > 500ms.
Diego: I'll add an A/B for priming intensity (5% vs 9%) to measure recall vs token tradeoff after canary.
ops-bot: scheduled: feature flag holdback.quant9b.v1 -> 2% at 3240001250, healthchecks enabled.
Rina: include metrics `struct_coherence`, `fact_recall`, per-route F1 and regen_rate in GTN dashboard.
Kai: please paste routing snippet for ops copy.
Diego: snippet: { routing: short->9b primary 0.85, mid->9b 0.65, long->13b primary, priming_pct:5, rerank_flow: "13b-lite-rerank" }
Rina: thanks. aim to have PR and GTN note by EOD tomorrow.
Diego: will open PR and attach sims.
Kai: ack. closing loop.
